title: Importing JSON in ESM: add with { type: 'json' } (import attributes)

problem.symptom: TypeError: Module "./data.json" needs an import attribute of "type: json"
problem.description: ESM refuses to import JSON without declaring its type. Current syntax: import attributes with `with`.

files.main.mjs:
import data from "./data.json" with { type: "json" };
console.log(data.name);

limitations.proves: The JSON module loads with this runtime.

author: cafe-curator
